name: 8248-longprompt-qwen2-7b-awq-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), nothing else on the card.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, warmup the first 10% by completion, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 2048 tokens and output EXACTLY 128 (min = max on both) with ignore_eos forced, so every request has the same shape. `request_format: plain`, which keeps the wire prompt at the declared 2048 tokens rather than 2048 plus a chat-template preamble. Synthetic English, no shared prefixes.
purpose: A document analysis assistant producing short summaries from long single-turn prompts, 64 concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# The launch config: `vllm serve --config` form. One engine, one H100.
#
# `quantization: awq` is load-bearing and must not be dropped: on an sm90 card an AWQ checkpoint
# is otherwise auto-converted to awq_marlin at load. Reaching the Triton AWQ ops additionally
# needs VLLM_USE_TRITON_AWQ=1, which is read at import time and so is carried in tuned.yaml.
# dtype is float16 because AWQConfig.get_supported_act_dtypes() here is [torch.half] alone.

model: Qwen/Qwen2-7B-Instruct-AWQ
quantization: awq
dtype: float16
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 32768
